description: Vue.js composable store module using Pinia for manufacturing cycle time (MCT) calculations, managing state related to production times and providing actions to compute total manufacturing cycle time and update time distributions.

methods.name: calculateProductMCT
methods.description: Calculates total manufacturing cycle time for a product based on its operations.

methods.name: updateTimeDistribution
methods.description: Updates the time distribution array based on a list of operations.
